correctness.rationale: The isolated rank-N disk spectrum gives a valid trace-norm second derivative; explicit Toeplitz boundary matrix elements and cancellation of within-cluster perturbations yield the stated convergent coefficient sum. Exact factorial-ratio expansion at x=N reduces to two checked finite polynomial sums producing (k²-1)/4; Stirling gives \(N^{-3/2}\). The checker passed 474 finite assertions. Nonnegativity is also a consequence of the cited global all-rank theorem, not an invented independent proof.

originality.rationale: Abreu establishes global optimality, not the full rank-indexed nonradial Hessian or the balanced-edge angular Jacobi multiplier. A known rank-two specialization is acknowledged and excluded as a novelty claim; Ramos treats the first eigenvalue. Searches comparing equivalences, stronger coverage, and spectral tables found no applicable dominating result. A general spectral shape-calculus treatment remains a residual originality risk.

value.rationale: The exact all-rank angular shape response and its universal balanced-edge Laplacian profile are natural quantitative refinements of the all-rank Fock Ky Fan optimization problem. The high-rank edge law gives a new continuum curvature invariant not obtainable by substituting parameters into the known rank-two case; no global optimizer or full uniqueness result is claimed.
